Gary Gygax and Dave Arneson and then developed by many others over the past 50 years

The 2024 Dungeon Master's Guide for Foundry Virtual Tabletop was produced by a group of Foundry VTT staff and contractors hand-selected from the Dungeons & Dragons Fifth Edition community. The below lists are sorted alphabetically.

Core Software Development

The system and this sourcebook would never be able to exist without the dedicated work of the Foundry VTT core development team:

  • Andrew Clayton

  • Ludovic Dey

  • Eber Höpfner

  • Kim Mantas

  • Richard Simões

System Development

The Dungeons & Dragons Fifth Edition game system on Foundry VTT owes its existence to an extensive list of volunteer developers to whom we will always be thankful. The vast majority of the development effort as part of the 4.1.0 Official release were contributed by:

  • Jeff Hitchcock

  • Kim Mantas

System Art

The custom artwork used throughout the character sheet were contributed by:

  • Mikiko (Contains Some NSFW Artwork)

The token ring used for every creature throughout the book and available for use in the system was contributed by:

  • Caeora

The Dynamic Token Engine

The dynamic token engine system and shaders were contributed by:

  • Ludovic Dey

Sourcebook Conversion

The conversion of the text, images, tables, scenes, and more into Foundry VTT were contributed by:

  • Matthew Haentschke

  • Matt Ryan

Token Creation

The creation of the portraits, tokens, and isolated subject artwork for use in the Dynamic Token Engine were contributed by:

  • Shane Martland

Partners at Wizards of the Coast

The creation of this sourcebook wouldn't have been possible without the help and support from our two primary contacts at Wizards of the Coast who helped us procure art, pushed for us to be able to make this the best conversion we could, handled the review process, and answered hundreds of questions. We would like to specially thank:

  • Head of Category Licensing & Business Development: Ann Earp

  • Associate Producer: Andy Smith
